caption: The drawing features two primary elements on a beige background. At the top, there is an outline sketch of a cylindrical container or pot with slightly flared sides and small handles on each side. The pot is depicted in a simple, dark blue line, and on its front surface there is a decorative, abstract blue motif, appearing somewhat floral or foliate, with an oval center and curved, petal- or leaf-like extensions. Below this, occupying the center of the composition, is a larger, more detailed rendering of the same blue motif, set against a soft, circular grayish-blue shaded background. The motif consists of a horizontally oriented oval filled with two small dots and framed by curved shapes that evoke a stylized flower or leaf design. The lines are all rendered in blue tones, and the shading around the central motif is done in gray.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
